subject.title: Add testing framework for cron jobs and skills (dry-run mode)

question: What no-side-effects contract should OpenClaw guarantee for cron and skills dry-run/testing, and should it share a request-scoped tool-interception contract with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/41418?
rationale: The missing source surface is clear, but the feature would define a public safety boundary plus new CLI, Gateway, protocol, skill-runner, and possible config semantics across cron, skills, tools, hooks, channels, and external APIs.

options.title: Design one request-scoped contract
options.body: Define cron test/validate, skills test, and shared tool-interception semantics together so preview modes provide the same side-effect guarantee across runtime paths.

options.title: Ship a narrow cron validator first
options.body: Add only cron config, schedule, and delivery validation while leaving skill testing and global interception to separate decisions.

options.title: Defer broad dry-run semantics
options.body: Keep current command-specific dry-run surfaces until a maintainer sponsors the broader trusted preview boundary.

recommendation.title: Design one request-scoped contract
recommendation.body: Define cron test/validate, skills test, and shared tool-interception semantics together so preview modes provide the same side-effect guarantee across runtime paths.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from current-source blame, prior issue review, and feature-history ownership across cron, skills, and shared tool execution surfaces.
